title: A Class of R\'enyi-based Concentration Metrics for Kolmogorov-Arnold Geometry in Multilayer Perceptrons
abstract: arXiv:2610.23267v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The interpretability of artificial intelligence models has become a central concern, especially for black-box models such as multilayer perceptrons (MLPs). Kolmogorov-Arnold Geometry has recently emerged as a framework for analysing the internal representations of these networks, by examining how the hidden layer locally responds to changes in the input through the minors of its Jacobian. The degree to which a few of these minors dominate the rest, known as their concentration, has so far been measured with the Participation Ratio. Although this metric has useful properties, its maximum value depends on the size of the network, so a given value cannot be read as high or low concentration without reference to the architecture. translated_title: 一类基于Rényi熵的多层感知机Kolmogorov-Arnold几何集中度度量
translated_abstract: 人工智能模型的可解释性已成为核心关注点，尤其是对于多层感知机（MLP）这类黑盒模型。Kolmogorov-Arnold几何最近兴起为一种分析此类网络内部表示的框架，它通过雅可比矩阵的子式来考察隐藏层对输入变化的局部响应。少数子式支配其余子式的程度被称为集中度，此前一直用参与率来衡量。尽管该指标具有一些有用的性质，但其最大值取决于网络规模，因此在不参照架构的情况下，无法将给定数值解读为高或低集中度。为克服这一局限，本文提出了α-RC度量，这是一族基于Rényi的集中度度量，通过将子式的归一化幅值与均匀分布进行比较……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一族基于Rényi熵的α-RC集中度度量，通过将多层感知机Kolmogorov-Arnold几何中雅可比子式的归一化幅值与均匀分布进行比较，克服了传统参与率指标因最大值依赖网络规模而无法跨架构解读集中度的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the α-RC metrics, a family of Rényi-based concentration measures that compare the normalized magnitudes of Jacobian minors with the uniform distribution in Kolmogorov-Arnold geometry of MLPs, overcoming the Participation Ratio's limitation of having a network-size-dependent maximum value.
